description: Blended score from multi-year CSR by count, ICR relative to peer segment, and claim processing metrics

bands.label: Excellent
bands.criteria: High CSR (>97%), healthy ICR (70-95%), low complaints, low Ombudsman awards

bands.label: Good
bands.criteria: Good CSR (92-97%), normal ICR, average complaints

bands.label: Average
bands.criteria: OK CSR (85-92%), acceptable ICR, moderate complaints

bands.label: Poor
bands.criteria: Poor CSR (<85%), extreme ICR (<60% or >105%), high complaints/awards
